profiles.title: Regular external component
profiles.description: An ordinary component delivered to the client.

rules.message: A regular component's key cannot contain solution or dmp-bundle. Choose the Solution or DMP Bundle profile.

profiles.title: Regular internal component
profiles.description: An ordinary component for internal use only.

rules.message: A regular component's key cannot contain solution or dmp-bundle. Choose the Solution or DMP Bundle profile.

profiles.title: Solution
profiles.description: A top-level component that groups and ships other components together.

rules.message: A solution key contains -solution, e.g. payments-solution.

profiles.title: DMP Bundle
profiles.description: A bundle component, also a solution, shipped as one distribution.

rules.message: A DMP bundle key contains dmp-bundle, e.g. payments-dmp-bundle.
